about: The slices the canary compares: two of ai-box-apps' golden cases (apps/printer/tests/goldens/cases.json), each as lab-printer's request for it goes out through Bambuddy - the stock presets by name, lab-printer's own process overrides (a one-filament plate: no prime tower; a towered one: the tower where the app puts it, at the pinned profiles' depth, and independent support layer height off), the build plate (lab-printer's plate parameter) and the filament map. The models are copies of the goldens' (models/, from ai-box-apps 591c47f0).

cases.name: towers-right-plabasic
cases.about: one filament, Bambu PLA Basic on the right nozzle

cases.name: pair-petg-left
cases.about: towered, Bambu PETG Basic and PETG HF on the left nozzle
